  - text: CLASS 11 • CONIC SECTIONS
  - heading "Hyperbola Standard Forms" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Explore both standard forms of a hyperbola. Adjust parameters, drag point P, and verify that |PF₁ − PF₂| = 2a (constant).
  - button "Reset explorer":
    - img
    - text: Reset explorer
  - main:
    - complementary:
      - heading "CHOOSE STANDARD FORM" [level=2]
      - group "Hyperbola orientation":
        - button "Horizontal x²/a² − y²/b² = 1"
        - button "Vertical y²/a² − x²/b² = 1"
      - heading "PARAMETERS (a, b > 0)" [level=2]
      - text: a (transverse)
      - slider "Transverse parameter a": "4"
      - status: "4.0"
      - text: b (conjugate)
      - slider "Conjugate parameter b": "3"
      - status: "3.0"
      - article:
        - heading "KEY VALUES" [level=2]
        - paragraph: a = 4.0
        - paragraph: b = 3.0
        - paragraph: c = √(a² + b²) = 5.000
        - paragraph: Eccentricity e = c/a = 1.250
      - article:
        - heading "CALCULATED ELEMENTS" [level=2]
        - paragraph: Vertices (±4.0, 0)
        - paragraph: Foci (±5.0, 0)
        - paragraph: Co-vertices (0, ±3.0)
        - paragraph: Asymptotes y = ±0.75x
        - paragraph: Conjugate Rect. 2a × 2b = 8.0 × 6.0
    - heading "HYPERBOLA EXPLORER" [level=2]
    - text: "Equation:"
    - strong: x²/16 − y²/9 = 1
    - img
    - text: Drag point P anywhere on the hyperbola
    - img "Interactive hyperbola graph": P (6.40, 3.75)
    - complementary:
      - paragraph: PF₁ = 12.00
      - paragraph: PF₂ = 4.00
      - paragraph: "|PF₁ − PF₂| = 8.00"
      - strong: = 2a = 8.00
      - img
      - text: Verified
    - article:
      - heading "ELEMENT SUMMARY" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Vertices (±4.0, 0)
      - paragraph: Foci (±5.0, 0)
      - paragraph: Asymptotes y = ±(b/a)x
      - paragraph: Eccentricity e = c/a > 1
    - article:
      - heading "BRANCHES" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Two separate branches open left and right along the transverse x-axis.
    - article:
      - heading "PROPERTIES" [level=2]
      - paragraph: ✓ |PF₁ − PF₂| = 2a for any point P
      - paragraph: ✓ Asymptotes intersect at the center
      - paragraph: ✓ The conjugate rectangle has sides 2a and 2b
      - paragraph: ✓ Eccentricity e > 1
